Now70s.uk.title: Tony Blackburn's Swinging 60s!
Now70s.uk.description: NOW 70s presents two hours of classic tunes from the decade before - the Swinging 60s. All brought to you by the man who was there - sensational Tony Blackburn.

Now70s.uk.title: Back To The 60s!
Now70s.uk.description: We're grooving back to the swinging 60s for classic videos, legendary artists & enough flower power to upset your local florist.

Now70s.uk.title: 60s v 70s Mixtape!
Now70s.uk.description: 28 hit songs, 14 top artists - one track as they were in the 60s, and another in the 70s - simple! From The Kinks to The King, John Lennon to Johnny Cash.

Now70s.uk.title: The NOW Yearbook 1971
Now70s.uk.description: At the top of the charts '71 started with an actor in a rocking chair & ended with a comedian on a milk float! In between we had Elton, Elvis, Rod, Diana, Cher, Slade & many more.

Now70s.uk.title: 1971 Unleashed!
Now70s.uk.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1971.

Now70s.uk.title: Rocket Man! Elton in the 70s
Now70s.uk.description: His national treasure status has grown with time, and every one of these songs is now considered a classic. These are Elton's big hits in order, from 1971's 'Your Song' onwards.

Now70s.uk.title: Rosko's Glam Rock! 1971-1974
Now70s.uk.description: Wham bam glam craziness with The Emperor spreading the love from Los Angeles! 3 years of music - 1971 to 1974 - that defined a decade and forged our fabulous fashions.

Now70s.uk.title: 70s Glam Slam!
Now70s.uk.description: Rewind to a time of big hair, outrageous makeup and platform shoes. The greatest gems of glam pop and rock, including Queen, ABBA and Wizzard.

Now70s.uk.title: Ballroom Blitz! 1967-1976
Now70s.uk.description: Celebrating the colourful world of glam rock, novelty pop & unforgettable chart hits that defined a distinctive era in UK music. Expect TV themes, Eurovision & plenty of glitter.

Now70s.uk.title: Pat Sharp's 25 Silly Songs!
Now70s.uk.description: Two hours of funny videos, silly songs and novelty hits - all of them amazing and all in the best possible taste.

Now70s.uk.title: Christmas Party Anthems! Top 20
Now70s.uk.description: 20 sing out loud classics from the 50s, 60s & 70s to get you in the festive spirit. You can thank us later.

Now70s.uk.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
Now70s.uk.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready.

Now70s.uk.title: Simply Having A Wonderful Xmas!
Now70s.uk.description: Feelgood hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready.

Now70s.uk.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
Now70s.uk.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready.

Now70s.uk.title: Morning Has Broken!
Now70s.uk.description: From the era of glam rock, new wave and disco, it's all the hits from just one decade - the 1970s! Platform boots and flares at the ready.

Now70s.uk.title: Hamilton's Hotshots! Top 30
Now70s.uk.description: In the mid-70s Diddy David Hamilton was on Radio 1 AND Radio 2 at the same time! And these are a choice selection of his records of the week - his "Hamilton's Hotshots".

Now70s.uk.title: Daydreamers: A Whole Day of Love!
Now70s.uk.description: Non-stop love songs, back to back all day, from the era of Leo Sayer, Carpenters, The Bee Gees & Minnie Riperton.

Now70s.uk.title: Ultimate Love Songs! 1970-1979
Now70s.uk.description: From 'Ticket To Ride' in 1970 to 'Please Don't Go' in 1979 - these are simply the 50 biggest love & break-up songs of the decade, in order.

Now70s.uk.title: Tony Blackburn's SingerSongwriters
Now70s.uk.description: From Joni Mitchell to Judie Tzuke, Al Green to Elton John - the 70s was a classic decade for singer-songwriters who have stood the test of time. Tony Blackburn chooses the tunes.

Now70s.uk.title: Hopelessly Devoted To You! Top 25
Now70s.uk.description: Another selection of classic love songs from the 70s.

Now70s.uk.title: Daydreamers: A Whole Day of Love!
Now70s.uk.description: Non-stop love songs, back to back all day, from the era of Leo Sayer, Carpenters, The Bee Gees & Minnie Riperton.

Now70s.uk.title: Bruno Brookes UK Top 40 of Xmas
Now70s.uk.description: A definite countdown of the UK's biggest Christmas singles of all time - spanning 7 decades of seasonal songs. Bruno Brookes has the festive facts & figures at hand.

Now70s.uk.title: 1972 Unleashed!
Now70s.uk.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1972.

Now70s.uk.title: Rod Stewart: 1971-1979
Now70s.uk.description: With 14 top 10 hits, Rod was beaten only by Elvis & Abba in the 70s. Here are 10 great videos, in order, from Maggie May onwards including a couple you may have forgotten.

Now70s.uk.title: American No.1s of 1972
Now70s.uk.description: In order - 12 videos that hit the top of the US chart in 1972. Some are obvious, but there are a few surprises along the way.

Now80s.uk.title: Every Number 2 of the 80s!
Now80s.uk.description: Can you believe none of these 145 songs reached number 1? Mark Goodier with 12 hours of classics - in order - that didn't quite have what it takes, but still sound fantastic.

Now80s.uk.title: 80s Flashback Frenzy!
Now80s.uk.description: Dramatic storylines, big dance routines, neon lights and iconic fashions - these are the classic music videos that made the 80s.

Now80s.uk.title: 10 Wham! Slammers
Now80s.uk.description: With just five years as a partnership, Andrew and George produced these 10 chart hits in the mid 1980s. George went on to greater things, but what happened to lovely Andrew.

Now80s.uk.title: The UK's Most Streamed Xmas Songs!
Now80s.uk.description: The 25 Xmas classics that have been the most streamed of all time in the UK! Ariana, Leona and Buble mix it up with old skool faves from Sinatra, Andy Williams and Nat King Cole.

Now80s.uk.title: 80s v 90s Xmas Party!
Now80s.uk.description: 25 classic seasonal songs - one from the '80s followed by one from the '90s - simple.

Now80s.uk.title: Your Festive Party Channel!
Now80s.uk.description: This is the soundtrack to your Christmas festivities - 80s style! Only the big party & singalong tunes back to back.

Now80s.uk.title: The Ultimate 80s Mix!
Now80s.uk.description: Dramatic storylines, big dance routines, neon lights and iconic fashions - these are the classic music videos that made the 80s.

Now80s.uk.title: Just Another Manic Monday!
Now80s.uk.description: Start the week feeling good and lookin' fine! We guarantee good time songs all day long - and only from the '80s.

Now80s.uk.title: Flamin' Heck! 10 Sizzling Videos
Now80s.uk.description: Whether they were setting things ablaze or just sitting by a bonfire, this lot were on fire in the '80s.

Now80s.uk.title: Limahl's Frocky Horror Show!
Now80s.uk.description: A cavalcade of clothing calamities and 'interesting choices' from superstars including Bowie, Madonna, Adam Ant, Bananarama, Queen, Wham, Five Star and maybe even Limahl himself.

Now80s.uk.title: Did They Really Do That? Top 30
Now80s.uk.description: Thirty fabulously great, but awful, hits and videos - all with that certain cringe factor attached. Did they really do that? They certainly did.

Now80s.uk.title: Just Another Manic Monday!
Now80s.uk.description: Start the week feeling good and lookin' fine! We guarantee good time songs all day long - and only from the '80s.

Now80s.uk.title: 101 Feelgood Anthems of the 80s!
Now80s.uk.description: Robin Banks with a mammoth singalong session of '80s anthems guaranteed to put you in the mood. From Belinda and Bananarama to Whitney and Wham! - a full-on decade of top tunes.

Now80s.uk.title: Just Another Manic Monday!
Now80s.uk.description: Start the week feeling good and lookin' fine! We guarantee good time songs all day long - and only from the '80s.

Now80s.uk.title: Christmas Stars - Then & Now!
Now80s.uk.description: Where are they now? Classic 80s hits, followed by some recent songs & Xmas anthems - Including Pet Shop Boys, Elton, Kylie, Abba, The Pretenders, The Beatles, Rick Astley & Bros.

NowRock.uk.title: The 25 Best Locks in Rock
NowRock.uk.description: Let your hair down as Claire Sturgess has a wild ride of fabulous follicles and awesome rock hairdos! From Bowie's glamorous transformations to Joe Elliot's indestructible mullet.

NowRock.uk.title: Sunday Rock Classics
NowRock.uk.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

NowRock.uk.title: Carol Decker's 1st Ladies of Rock!
NowRock.uk.description: T'Pau's Carol Decker with 30 years of the most amazing women who ROCK! From Grace Slick in the 60s to Florence Welch in the 00s - these ladies all left an incredible mark.

NowRock.uk.title: Weekend Anthems!
NowRock.uk.description: Turn it up to 11 all weekend for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock!

NowRock.uk.title: 99 Reasons The 00s Rocked!
NowRock.uk.description: 99 anthems of rock from the noughties! With Green Day, Linkin Park, The Strokes, Paramore, Blink-182, The Killers & much more!

NowRock.uk.title: Blazing Rock Ballads!
NowRock.uk.description: Rock ballads from Queen, Bon Jovi, Whitesnake, Meat Loaf, Nickleback and Evanescence.

NowRock.uk.title: Turn Up The 00s Soft Rock
NowRock.uk.description: Turn up your speakers to 11 for 30 of the finest soft rock tracks from the noughties! Starting in 2000, featuring tracks from Keane, Nickleback Snow Patrol & Evanescence.
